note: A new, blank app, made by the Launcher: it copies this file to <apps folder>/<name>/index.screen.json and writes the app's name over each "New app" in it. Its paths name ../shared, the copy of examples/shared beside the apps. The assistant opens at once, to build the app with the person.

en.blank.hint: This app is empty, for now. Tell the assistant what it should be, in your own words: it proposes each change, and you accept or undo it.
en.blank.example: For example: “A reading list with a title, an author and a rating for each book.”

es.blank.hint: Esta app está vacía, de momento. Dile al asistente qué debe ser, con tus palabras: propone cada cambio, y tú lo aceptas o lo deshaces.
es.blank.example: Por ejemplo: «Una lista de lecturas con el título, el autor y una nota para cada libro».

fr.blank.hint: Cette app est vide, pour l'instant. Dites à l'assistant ce qu'elle doit être, avec vos mots : il propose chaque changement, que vous acceptez ou annulez.
